audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said 'Skill' for Levels 2 through First item and gave Quinn the 2+ item row, while the prose (whys[6], late, spikes[3]) says Urgot reclaims the game at two items.
audit.why: Emerald+ win rate is 56.92% over 253 games and the packet levelChart is Quinn for rows 0-5 and Urgot for row 6. Quinn out-ranges Urgot (Q 1025 / R-less poke vs Purge 490) and blinds his auto-based damage; Urgot's percent-max-HP Purge and Fear Beyond Death execute flip it once he is tanky.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 Quinn, row 6 Urgot, in both layers.
sources: kit ranges Purge 490 vs Quinn Q 1025

audit.why: Spike structure (Lvl 1-3 blind window, Lvl 6 roam, 1st item lethality, Late Urgot) matches the kit: Purge cooldown drops 12/9/6/3/0 so his DPS scales hard with ranks and items, while Quinn's early edge is Harrier resets plus the Q blind.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never names Echoing Flames, Corrosive Charge, Purge, Disdain or Fear Beyond Death with numbers, and never states that Behind Enemy Lines is a channel Urgot can cancel.
audit.why: Disdain (E) is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, 475 range, shields him and applies hard CC; Fear Beyond Death (R) is 100/85/70s with an execute threshold. Both are CC and therefore cancel Quinn's R channel (ownerKit R flag: 'channel — interruptible, any CC cancels it'). This is the decisive interaction of the matchup and was absent.
audit.corrected: Disdain (E) shields him, hurls you, and cancels your R channel; Fear Beyond Death likewise. Bait Disdain, then commit; only channel R once his CC is spent.
sources: enemyKit E/R hardCC flags and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown section named Disdain but gave no duration, so 'track it' had nothing to track.
audit.why: Disdain is 16s at rank 1 and only 14s maxed; Fear Beyond Death is 100s at rank 1. Concrete numbers make the commit window real.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with rank-1 and maxed values.
